_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: near_eastern (akkadian) backbone + east_asian (sinitic) overlay (cross-family blend, Mesopotamian-leaning)

blend.backbone: near_eastern (akkadian: the alu/bit river-cities, the sangu temple-priesthood, the scribal ekallu, construct-chain toponyms, emphatic gutturals sh/q/kh/', triconsonantal roots, -u/-um endings, SOV agglutinative grammar, penultimate stress)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the walled cheng and the Mandate-of-Heaven bureaucracy, the mandarin officialdom, the silk and jade and tea trade, the river-junk and the canal, monosyllabic meaning-roots)
blend.lean: Mesopotamian-heavy - the cuneiform scribe and the mandarin folded into one ministry: an Akkadian temple-and-stele bureaucracy that absorbed a Sinitic river-realm, so the ziggurat and the pagoda stand on the same terrace and the law-tablet and the examination-roll are filed in the same Bit-ili. The Akkadian rule/temple register governs; the Sinitic material-and-river world is the substrate it administers.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_03 Shinarur (Mesopotamian) x BASE_09 (Sinitic/Chinese). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both bases are Civilized, so Huashinar is Civilized (feudal). Concept: an Akkadian-Sinitic fusion - the cuneiform scribe and the mandarin as one bureaucracy, ziggurat and pagoda on one terrace ('Hua' the Sinitic flower-realm + 'Shinar' the Mesopotamian river-plain). Backbone = Akkadian (the alu-cities, the bit-ili temples, the scribal-priestly ministry, the construct-chain toponyms, the law-stele); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the walled cheng, the Mandate bureaucracy, the silk/jade/tea/river-junk material world). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Akkadian and Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY per hammuran, Sinitic morphs SECONDARY per family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic), never real Mesopotamian/Chinese gods. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (no approved foreign term covers a cuneiform-mandarin throne); conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native (Akkadian) for NPC dialogue. Deities via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Near-Eastern (Akkadian) backbone - emphatic and guttural consonants (q, kh, h, ', sh, ts), triconsonantal roots, a/i/u vowels, -u/-um/-tu endings, penultimate stress, construct chains - meeting a Sinitic overlay: monosyllabic meaning-roots (jiang, si, yu, cha, cheng), only -n/-ng codas in the source, no native clusters. Per the CSV: tonal contours (the Sinitic source heard as pitch-glide, unmarked) over emphatic Akkadian consonants; grammar SOV with isolating-agglutinative case-inflection (the Sinitic monosyllables strung as Akkadian construct-chains and fitted to CVC + -u/-um). Theophoric on the Akkadian reflexes (Tullaru-, Urlandu-, Numunu-) with Sinitic court-variants (Tuli-, Aolan-, Numeng-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; Akkadian mimation -um and construct-chains absorbing Sinitic monosyllables; Sinitic -n/-ng codas retained where they fit (jangu, langu); emphatics sh/q/kh/' frequent; stress penultimate (the Akkadian pull); dithematic-free - names build by Bit-/Dur-/Kar- construct over fitted Sinitic roots.

sound_changes: Sinitic tones dropped entirely (the source pitch heard only as a contour, never marked); the isolating monosyllable is the input root
Sinitic monosyllabic roots fitted to Akkadian CVC and given an Akkadian noun-ending -u/-um (jiang>jangu, si>sibu, cha>shabu, yu>ubu); only -n/-ng codas survive, other Sinitic codas resolve to -u
Sinitic affricates/retroflexes collapse into the Akkadian inventory: zh/ch/sh>sh, j/q/x>sh or s, r>l; no Sinitic tone, no Sinitic -ian/-uan glide (reduced to -an/-a)
strings of Sinitic morphemes become Akkadian construct-chains (cheng-bao > ekalbu by portmanteau, jin-cheng > kasap-sheng); compounds head-final per SOV
Akkadian penultimate stress and triconsonantal feel imposed on every root from either parent; retain Akkadian sh/q/kh/' and the few surviving Sinitic -ng codas as the audible double-ancestry
fusion_rules.source_tilt: river/silk/jade/tea/bronze/material/bureaucratic words from Sinitic roots (the substrate works the looms, the canals, the ledgers); rule/kin-line/temple/land/quality/war words from Akkadian roots (the governing register); every root then filtered to one Akkadian-shaped phonology so the seam is inaudible

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Akkadian rule/kin/temple/land-roots + Sinitic river/silk/material/bureaucratic-roots, all run through one Akkadian-shaped sound-law (Sinitic tones dropped, monosyllables fitted to CVC + -u/-um, strung as construct-chains, penultimate stress); portmanteaus mark the blended cuneiform-mandarin institutions and the fused bloodline. No slashes - one word per concept.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Akkadian governing line keeps the 'mar-' (son of) patronymic and theophoric constructs; the Sinitic substrate keeps a clan-surname placed first (xing-fitted), but under the throne the construct wins - a Bit- house-name absorbing the old Sinitic xing; order given-first for the Akkadian register, surname-first survives among the cheng-folk.

gendered_endings.male: -u / -um (Akkadian governing); fitted Sinitic auspicious roots take -u

morphology.compounding_rule: Akkadian construct-chains (Bit-[god], Dur-[ruler], Kar-[god], resource + feature) absorbing fitted Sinitic meaning-compounds (quality/feature + type): the capital Hua-shinar (the flower-realm of the river-plain), Dur-Tullaru (fort of Tullaru), Kasap-sheng (the golden city, < jin-cheng).

title_ladder.government: feudal (an Akkadian temple-and-stele bureaucracy over a Sinitic Mandate-realm: the sharru and his rubu-kin at the crown, the shaknu-governors over the alsheng-cities, the scribal-priestly ekallu and the mandarin officialdom folded into one ministry; the sangu-priesthood and the examination-clerk serve the same throne)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Akkadian ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic substrate court-titles beneath. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march; Shaknu (appointed governor) county; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality; Sharru (king) kingdom over a Sharrutu, who also holds the Mandate (the Tianming, fitted Tinminu); Shar-kishshati (the king-of-the-totality; Akk) emperor over the Kishshatu, the Sinitic huangdi recast as the Akkadian king-of-kings. The absorbed cheng keep their Sinitic dudu (frontier commander) and wang (under-king) as co-titles beneath the Akkadian crown; the mandarin guan (official) and the scribal shatammu staff the one ministry. Rank titles fuse the real Akkadian and Chinese registers (allowed); DISPLAY titles are English.
title_ladder.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king / crown prince; the Akkadian heir-title, the Sinitic Taizi recast)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (no approved commonly-known foreign term covers a cuneiform-mandarin throne; English display titles used). The *_native conlang forms (Akkadian) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Akkadian governing stock carry a theophoric given name + mar- patronymic or Bit- house; the Sinitic substrate keep a clan-surname (xing-fitted) first + given name; the throne fuses both - a theophoric construct over an absorbed Sinitic clan-name; order given-first for the governing register.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Akkadian temple-and-court line keep theophoric constructs (X-iddina, Warad-X) on the morphed canon-stems; the Sinitic cheng-folk keep a clan-surname + auspicious given name fitted to Akkadian phonology (Liu-, Wangu-, Shaofeng > Shaufenu).
people_name_convention.theophoric: Akkadian devotional constructs on the morphed canon-stems: Warad-Tullaru (servant of Tullaru), Tullaru-iddina (Tullaru-gave-me); the Sinitic register invokes the celestial powers' epithets and the Mandate rather than the god-name (Tinminu-en, heaven's-grace) and names temple-children for Tuli-di recast as Tullaru.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY (family_near_eastern / hammuran morphs: Tullaru, Urlandu, Numunu, Gayandu, Rialtu), Sinitic celestial morphs SECONDARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic: Tuli, Aolan, Numeng, Gaidun, Lianta), never real Mesopotamian/Chinese gods. The Akkadian temple-stele tradition and the Sinitic Mandate-of-Heaven are read as one order: the law-tablet IS the celestial register. All three alignments.
religion.the_one: Itarnu (Akk; Sin Aiteng) - the Highest Heaven and the great distant one, the source of the Mandate, honored not petitioned

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and judgment, the Sun-Justice power of the stele and the celestial register

Gaiandus.gloss: the enduring earth, lord of mountains and the grain-altar

Numeno.gloss: sky and scribe-wisdom, patron of the cuneiform-and-mandarin ministry

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Itarnu, Tullaru the just, Urlandu of the sworn war, Rialtu the merciful - filed in the celestial register and inscribed on the law-stele; names the Chaotic powers -lemnu (evil) or mo (demon-marshals), warded; the law-tablet and the Mandate bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the deified abu of the ruling Bit-houses and the zu-lineages of the cheng) and the local earth-and-grain powers of the bit-ili and the Miao; the great powers invoked at the ziggurat-terrace and the pagoda situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Itarnu - as the tyrant-gods and the false Mandate to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as -lemnu (Akkadian evil) or mo (Sinitic demon-marshals), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner (Sin Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking (Sin Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanu the Coin-Serpent (Sin Lusan).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (Akkadian god-house) or Miao (fitted Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru', 'the Miao of Tuli'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu beneath the temple-stele.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and worthy officials enrolled both on the temple-stele and in the celestial register, honored at the ziggurat-terrace, the Ci (ancestral shrine), and the Miao; 'the Just [name]' / 'the Lord [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gayandu: the alluvial grain-field beneath the ziggurat and the green mountain
